screen_replay.instrument: Photo/video of victim on a phone or monitor

vcam_offline_faceswap.instrument: Offline deepfake (victim face swapped onto attacker video)

vcam_synthetic_gan.method: Virtual camera; label spoofed in 50% of attempts

emulator_injection.method: Android emulator / rooted device with camera hook (VCAM-style module)
emulator_injection.description: Mobile camera API hooked; attestation usually fails

challenge_aware_injection.instrument: Pre-recorded genuine video of victim, re-lit in real time

challenge_aware_faceswap.instrument: Real-time face swap of a live attacker, re-lit in real time
